signal: Nue launched Nue AI and is expanding AI-guided selling, pricing, and agentic experiences across its revenue lifecycle platform into 2026, after a $20M Series A.

email.body1:
Lisa, saw Nue rolled out Nue AI and is pushing AI-guided selling across the revenue lifecycle into 2026.

A category move that fast usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps catch up, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Nue off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Lisa, quick follow-up for Nue.

As the AI story expands, growth targets tend to climb faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Nue needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Lisa, last bit of proof for Nue.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Nue's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Lisa, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after a category launch, timing is everything, and I know that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to Nue's motion? I will tailor it to you either way.
